rationale: The mouse delivery/renderer behavior can plausibly be labelled BrowserWindow or webcontents, but the report supplies no finer component isolation. blocked/need-info ❌ already asks for a supported version. Prose and one-line console diagnostics would otherwise leave a reproduction gap. The known 48311 report is already linked and explicitly described as different. Retrieved first-click loss, crash/reload click-through and fullscreen ghost-window reports have distinct triggers. The report is an Electron development-mode bug claim, not an app-only support request; no upstream reproduction is provided.
